title: char_select
summary: MSUI realizes the current desktop character-select arc: full-bleed skinned chrome over the selected race's geared booth, roster enumeration, Enter World, Back, rule-owned host/tuning windows and typed-name Delete confirmation, character creation and logout return. The Delete modal now uses the current 512x256 geometry, alert icon, authored chat-input border and exact accept/cancel glue sounds. Current Benilla additionally exposes an AddOns panel only when installed addons exist. MSUI has no addon VM/discovery/enabled-state consumer, so its formerly always-visible disabled cosmetic AddOns button is omitted instead of advertising a dead control; implementing the panel remains correctly contingent on actual addon compatibility.

openItems.text: MSUI always displayed a disabled cosmetic AddOns button even though it has no installed-addon consumer; current Benilla hides the button when no addons are installed.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Removed the unreachable cosmetic AddOns button. The character-select action cluster and booth drag remain unchanged, and a focused source check prevents the dead control from returning.

openItems.text: The character-select host, tuning window and typed Delete confirmation retained authored geometry in the renderer; the confirmation also omitted the reference alert icon, authored chat-input border and accept/cancel glue sounds.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: CharSelectUiLaw now owns the full-screen host, 360-wide tuning window, centered 512x256 modal, 64x64 alert, 130x32 edit field with its two authored border pieces, and 200x40 button seats. Accept and Cancel/Escape play gsTitleOptionOK and gsTitleOptionExit respectively. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: If MSUI gains real addon/Lua compatibility, port current Benilla's rule-owned character-select AddOns modal, installed manifest discovery, per-character tri-state enable staging, version gate, scrollbar/tooltips, and Okay/Cancel persistence. Until that consumer exists, do not add a disconnected modal or filesystem subsystem.
